subject.title: fix(qa-lab): reject hex/exponent Telegram SUT uid env values

question: Should Telegram QA SUT UID, GID, and cleanup-timeout environment values now fail closed on hexadecimal, exponent, and fractional forms?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well proven, but it deliberately removes previously accepted input forms from an operator-facing QA harness contract.

options.title: Accept decimal-only contract
options.body: Merge the strict parser and treat non-decimal forms as malformed inputs while retaining valid decimal and plus-prefixed decimal values.

options.title: Preserve permissive compatibility
options.body: Pause the PR and define an explicit compatibility path if maintained QA launchers are expected to rely on JavaScript numeric syntax.

recommendation.title: Accept decimal-only contract
recommendation.body: Merge the strict parser and treat non-decimal forms as malformed inputs while retaining valid decimal and plus-prefixed decimal values.

likelyOwner.reason: The Telegram QA lane history is the closest available ownership signal for deciding its environment contract.
